_fixture_metadata.reason: Forces the resolver to choose between the operator's `business_date` (Vancouver-local) and the UTC timestamp wire shape. Per `docs/contracts/phase_7_55_time_boundary_contract.md`, restaurant-local timing wins; `business_date` is derived from the location's `restaurant_local_tz`, not from the wire-shape timezone. ADP emits UTC; the deriver maps UTC -> America/Vancouver -> `business_date`.
_fixture_metadata.wire_format_note: ADP emits UTC; if the partner doc reveals a per-location wire shape (e.g. `+00:00` offsets pinned to ADP's data-center clock), the resolver still anchors to America/Vancouver.

time_event._local_anchor_note: shift_start UTC = 02:30Z 2026-05-05; America/Vancouver = 19:30 PDT 2026-05-04. shift_end UTC = 08:00Z 2026-05-05; America/Vancouver = 01:00 PDT 2026-05-05. Wire-shape calendar day differs from local business date — the resolver must pick local.
